subject: [PATCH 04/60] mm/page_alloc: build zonelists from common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new approach to building zonelists from common memory, which should improve performance. However, it's unclear whether this change is necessary or sufficient to address the underlying issues.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch refactors the build_zonelists() function to construct zonelists from common memory, reducing unnecessary allocations and improving performance. It achieves this by building fallback zonelists from N_MEMORY_COMMON nodes and local-only zonelists for common nodes. The build_local_zonelist() refactor allows for code reuse in constructing a local-only zonelist for nodes outside the N_MEMORY_COMMON set.
